GROW.content:
# Healthcare Compliance Research

Reviewed HIPAA Security Rule requirements and encryption standards from CMS official documentation.

## Compliance Requirements
Data at rest must use AES-256 encryption. Data in transit requires TLS 1.2 minimum. Audit logs must be immutable for 7 years.
GROW.summary: Researched HIPAA compliance framework from official CMS sources.

FRAME.content:
# Healthcare Data Architecture PRD

## Compliance Approach
Implement end-to-end AES-256 encryption with immutable audit trails per HIPAA requirements documented at https://example.com/verified/hipaa-security-rule.

## Architecture Decision
Use managed database services with built-in encryption and 7-year retention policies. We follow TLS 1.2+ as mandated by the HIPAA Security Rule, noting that while TLS 1.3 offers forward secrecy, TLS 1.2 compliance is sufficient for regulatory requirements.

## Risk Mitigations
Monitored access controls address potential unauthorized data exposure risks highlighted in compliance research.
